audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer gives Qiyana all seven chart rows and calls the matchup HARD 8/10, while the content layer already flips to Skill at 6 and Lux at first item — and Lux wins 53.56% over 1111 games.
audit.why: Two layers rendering different answers to 'who wins Level 6' is the exact defect regression-check fails on. The content layer matches the win rate and the kit: Audacity is 650 range, Light Binding is 1175.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side Skill, phases[5].side Lux, phases[6].side Lux — matching win[4..6], which were already correct. diff EVEN, diffRating 6/10.

audit.why: The four spikes are already accurate in shape: her window is 3-5, level 6 is a coin-flip of ults, first item and late are Lux. Supreme Display of Talent in spikes[1] is the real Riot name — the suspectNames hit is a false positive.
audit.corrected: phases[4..6].why rewritten with real numbers (R 120s, Audacity 650, Light Binding 1175) to match the moved sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states the two numbers that decide the lane: Audacity's range/cooldown and Terrashape's 7s re-element dash off any wall. breakdown.cooldowns had no digit at all.
audit.why: Audacity is 650 range on 11/10/9/8/7s and is her only way onto you; Terrashape is a 7s, 1100-range dash that also charges her element, so a wall near the wave means she arrives already empowered. Her R is 120s flat at every rank and creates terrain plus a knockup.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[2].d, breakdown.feeding and enemyWin.

edits.before: Final Spark online — anything the root catches dies to the laser math. The lane becomes a geometry quiz.
edits.after: Final Spark online — her R is 120s flat; if she spends it and misses, the laser answers from 3340 range.

edits.before: Luden's spike: Q-E-R deletes squishies from root range. Force her to dodge or die on every contact.
edits.after: Luden's spike: Q-E-R deletes her from 1175 while Audacity only reaches 650. She has to come to you.

edits.before: Late Lux decides fights from a screen away: root the entry, slow the pit, and laser the clump your team froze.
edits.after: Late Lux decides fights from a screen away: root her Audacity entry, slow the pit, and laser the clump held still.

edits.before: - Qiyana Audacity: matchup-defining — Her stick dash — once spent she cannot reach you; kite the cooldown. Check it before every step-up. - W Prismatic Barrier is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Qiyana Audacity: 11s at rank 1, 7s at rank 5, and only 650 range — step up on its downtime. - Terrashape is a 7s dash she uses to re-element, so it is not a reliable escape. - Her R is 120s flat: bait it, then commit.

edits.before: Her stick dash — once spent she cannot reach you; kite the cooldown. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Audacity is 650 range on an 11s cooldown at rank 1 — once spent, your 1175 Light Binding is uncontested.

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, weave the passive auto, and keep Q visibly loaded — the chip is free and the root threat does the zoning.
edits.after: She re-elements off any wall with a 7s Terrashape, so a flank bush or wall lets her arrive already empowered — ward both sides.

edits.before: Qiyana spends Audacity early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Shoved waves cost her the roam; her R is 120s and she wants it for your team.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown and facing the dive with an empty root slot — Lux without the binding banked is everyone's favorite snack.
edits.after: Lucent Singularity is 10s at rank 1 and it is your slow — burn it for a detonation and her 650-range Audacity has nothing to cross.

edits.before: Qiyana wins by landing Audacity, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Qiyana wins by dashing Audacity into you with an element charged, then stunning you off a wall with her R.

edits.before: Carry through the root-laser pipeline — one binding per fight, converted at screen range; your job is owning the geometry that makes it land.
edits.after: Carry by punishing her approach: she must close 650 with Audacity, and Light Binding into Final Spark converts that dash into a corpse.

edits.before: If Qiyana gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Audacity extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with E clears and stay relevant through root picks.
edits.after: If Qiyana gets a kill, stop standing anywhere a wall is within 650 of you — that is her Terrashape into Audacity entry. Farm with E from 1100 and hold Q purely as peel.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8/10, Qiyana carry threat 8.5/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, Qiyana carry threat 8.5/10.

edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, Qiyana carry threat 8.5/10.
